summary_en: Emergency Assistance Japan authorized acquisition of up to 100,000 shares (3.97% of outstanding shares) for maximum ¥100 million through market purchases from December 1, 2026 to November 30, 2027 to improve capital efficiency and shareholder returns toward ROE target of 8–10%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 18, 2026, Emergency Assistance Japan's Board of Directors resolved to acquire up to 100,000 shares of common stock (3.97% of outstanding shares, based on 2,519,134 shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026, excluding treasury stock) for a maximum aggregate expenditure of ¥100 million. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from December 1, 2026 to November 30, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback program is intended to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns as part of its mid-term business plan "EAJ Next Vision 2025-2027," which targets a return on equity (ROE) of 8–10%. No maximum price per share was disclosed.
